description: This Java class 'RomeEventHandler' handles web events related to RSS feed generation within the OFBiz framework. It initializes a feed output, generates links, invokes a feed service, and outputs the RSS feed to the response.

classes.name: RomeEventHandler
classes.description: A class implementing EventHandler to process web events for RSS feed generation using Rome library within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the event handler, setting up the service handler and feed output.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Handles the event, generates links, invokes the feed service, and writes the RSS feed to the response.
